title: Compile explicit all-rank physical Poincare constants with finite recursive BIT costs
statement: Original rates at a finite-control node are >= kappa_*(1+V)^(-(m_*-1)); class size is <= (A+1)^d(1+V)^d. The constructed root paths and weighted Cauchy-Schwarz, counting original directed edges with the specified one-half Dirichlet form, give C_node=max(1,2(A+1)^d L0^2 H^(d*b0)/kappa_*) and D_node=d+m_*+1+d*b0. Compute the control graph, lattice, Graver words, buffer and backward core-access basis; find K by the terminating module-inclusion search; create children encoding each possible globally bounded coordinate. Branching is finite and depth <= d. Zero-coordinate leaves have finite-control paths. Output C=max_nodes C_node and D=max_nodes D_node. Every actual class at every V either reaches a node core or lies entirely in a child, proving Var_piV(f)<=C(1+V)^D E_V(f,f) in the original physical clock. Fixed-input BIT cost and output length have a finite recursive bound, without a polynomial-in-B claim. Optional class enumeration has <=(AV+1)^d states and loose O_fixed((1+V)^(d+10)) BIT cost. Comparisons use exact rational weights; a requested normalizer is a paid finite sum. No random, real-number, mixing or PDE oracle is supplied or needed by the stated construction.

It computes finite control graphs, physical words, integer lattices and Graver bases, backward antichain saturation, and a proved-terminating Groebner module-inclusion search. Enumerating all valid inputs of length <= B and running the terminating compiler defines a recursive worst-case bit-operation and output-length bound; no polynomial-in-B bound is claimed. Optional per-V class enumeration has at most (AV+1)^d states, rational weight heights O_fixed(V log(2+V)), and loose BIT work O_fixed((1+V)^(d+10)).
